title: Intervention Just Before Irreversible Action: Real-Time Tripwires in Agentic Pipelines

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Compelling chain: build irreversibility classifier -> hold flagged actions for human review -> measure detection rate. Last line of defense before harm. Even 70% recall prevents most harmful mistakes. Intermediate deliverable (the classifier) has independent value.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Building a classifier for action irreversibility is moderately complex but uses standard ML tools. The agent pipeline integration and override window mechanics add engineering complexity. Feasible with mentor guidance and medium compute.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: true positive rate, false positive rate, and override usage for the tripwire on 30 tasks. Single system to build and evaluate with well-defined metrics.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
